395:         try {

401:                 try {

407:                         return out;

410:                     c = (HttpURLConnection) u.openConnection();
411:                     c.setRequestMethod("GET");
412:                     c.setConnectTimeout(12000);
413:                     c.setReadTimeout(15000);
414:                     c.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false);
415:                     c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "ISA-Admin/1.0");
416:                     c.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
417:                     c.setRequestProperty("Range", "bytes=0-0");
418: 
419:                     int code = c.getResponseCode();
420: 
421:                     out.put("http_code", code);
422:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
423: 
424:                     if (code == 404) {
425:                         out.put("status", "skip404");
426:                     } else if (code >= 300 && code < 400) {
427:                         out.put("status", "redirect");
428:                     } else if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
429:                         out.put("status", "ok");
430:                     } else {
431:                         out.put("status", "error");
432:                     }
433: 
434:                     return out;
435: 
436:                 } catch (Exception e) {
437:                     if (attempt == 0 && isConnectionReset(e)) continue;
438: 
439:                     out.put("status", "error");
440:                     out.put("message",
441:                         e.getMessage() == null ? "Bağlantı hatası" : e.getMessage());
442:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
443:                     return out;
444: 
445:                 } finally {
446:                     if (c != null) c.disconnect();
447:                 }
448:             }
449: 
450:         } catch (Exception e) {
451:             try {
452:                 out.put("status", "error");
453:                 out.put("message", e.getMessage());
454:             } catch (Exception ignored) {}

1757:             item.screenshot_uri || item.poster ||
1758:             item.poster_url || item.movie_image_url || ""
1759:         ),
1760:         poster_url: String(
1761:             item.poster_url || item.poster || item.cover_big ||
1762:             item.movie_image || item.stream_icon || item.cover ||
1763:             item.screenshot_uri || item.logo || ""
1764:         ),
1765:         posters: [...new Set([
1766:             item.poster_url, item.poster, item.cover_big,
1767:             item.movie_image, item.stream_icon, item.cover,
1768:             item.screenshot_uri, item.logo
1769:         ].filter(Boolean).map(String))],

1772:         ),
1781:         map.set(key, entry);
1782:     } else {

1785:         if (!old.logo && entry.logo) old.logo = entry.logo;

1787:         if (!old.url && entry.url) old.url = entry.url;

1789:             ...(old.posters || []),

545:     private JSONObject scanOne(String address, int selectedHop) {
546:         JSONObject out = new JSONObject();
547:         selectedHop = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, selectedHop));
548: 
549:         for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
550:             HttpURLConnection connection = null;
551: 
552:             try {
553:                 String current = address;
554:                 JSONArray chain = new JSONArray();
555:                 chain.put(address);
556: 
557:                 java.util.HashSet<String> visited =
558:                     new java.util.HashSet<>();
559:                 visited.add(address);
560: 
561:                 int followed = 0;
568:                     if (!"http".equalsIgnoreCase(protocol) &&
569:                         !"https".equalsIgnoreCase(protocol)) {
570:                         throw new Exception("HTTP veya HTTPS adresi gerekli.");
571:                     }
572: 
573:                     connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
574:                     connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
575:                     connection.setConnectTimeout(12000);
576:                     connection.setReadTimeout(15000);
577:                     connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false);
578:                     connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "ISA-Admin/1.0");
579:                     connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
580:                     connection.setRequestProperty("Range", "bytes=0-0");
581: 
582:                     code = connection.getResponseCode();
583: 
584:                     if (code == 404) {
585:                         out.put("url", address);
586:                         out.put("original_url", address);
587:                         out.put("selected_url", current);
588:                         out.put("selected_hop", followed);
589:                         out.put("http_code", 404);
590:                         out.put("status", "skip404");
591:                         out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
592:                         return out;
593:                     }
594: 
595:                     boolean redirect = code == 301 || code == 302 ||
596:                         code == 303 || code == 307 || code == 308;
597: 
598:                     if (redirect && followed < selectedHop) {
599:                         String location = connection.getHeaderField("Location");
600: 
601:                         if (location == null || location.trim().isEmpty()) {
602:                             out.put("status", "error");
603:                             out.put("message", "Redirect Location başlığı bulunamadı.");
604:                             out.put("http_code", code);
605:                             out.put("original_url", address);
606:                             out.put("selected_url", current);
607:                             out.put("selected_hop", followed);
608:                             out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
609:                             return out;
610:                         }
611: 
612:                         String next = new URL(url, location.trim()).toString();
613: 
614:                         if (visited.contains(next)) {
615:                             out.put("status", "error");
616:                             out.put("message", "Yönlendirme döngüsü tespit edildi.");
617:                             out.put("http_code", code);
618:                             out.put("original_url", address);
619:                             out.put("selected_url", current);
620:                             out.put("selected_hop", followed);
621:                             out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
622:                             return out;
623:                         }
624: 
625:                         visited.add(next);
626:                         chain.put(next);
627:                         followed++;
628:                         current = next;
629: 
630:                         connection.disconnect();
631:                         connection = null;
632:                         continue;
633:                     }
634: 
635:                     out.put("url", address);
636:                     out.put("original_url", address);
637:                     out.put("selected_url", current);
638:                     out.put("selected_hop", followed);
639:                     out.put("http_code", code);
640:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
641:                     out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
642: 
643:                     if ((code >= 200 && code < 300) || redirect) {
644:                         out.put("status", redirect ? "redirect" : "ok");
645:                     } else {
646:                         out.put("status", "error");
647:                         out.put("message", "HTTP " + code);
648:                     }
649: 
650:                     return out;
651:                 }
652: 
653:             } catch (Exception error) {
654:                 if (attempt == 0 && isConnectionReset(error)) {
655:                     continue;
656:                 }
657: 
658:                 try {
659:                     out.put("url", address);
660:                     out.put("original_url", address);

663:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
664:                     out.put("message", error.getMessage() == null
665:                         ? "Bağlantı hatası" : error.getMessage());
666:                 } catch (Exception ignored) {}
667: 
668:                 return out;
669:

674:

586:                         out.put("original_url", address);
587:                         out.put("selected_url", current);
588:                         out.put("selected_hop", followed);
589:                         out.put("http_code", 404);
590:                         out.put("status", "skip404");
591:                         out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
592:                         return out;
593:                     }
594: 
595:                     boolean redirect = code == 301 || code == 302 ||
596:                         code == 303 || code == 307 || code == 308;
597: 
598:                     if (redirect && followed < selectedHop) {
599:                         String location = connection.getHeaderField("Location");
600: 
601:                         if (location == null || location.trim().isEmpty()) {
602:                             out.put("status", "error");
603:                             out.put("message", "Redirect Location başlığı bulunamadı.");
604:                             out.put("http_code", code);
605:                             out.put("original_url", address);
606:                             out.put("selected_url", current);
607:                             out.put("selected_hop", followed);
608:                             out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
609:                             return out;
610:                         }
611: 
612:                         String next = new URL(url, location.trim()).toString();
613: 
614:                         if (visited.contains(next)) {
615:                             out.put("status", "error");
616:                             out.put("message", "Yönlendirme döngüsü tespit edildi.");
617:                             out.put("http_code", code);
618:                             out.put("original_url", address);
619:                             out.put("selected_url", current);
620:                             out.put("selected_hop", followed);
621:                             out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
622:                             return out;
623:                         }
624: 
625:                         visited.add(next);
626:                         chain.put(next);
627:                         followed++;
628:                         current = next;
629: 
630:                         connection.disconnect();
631:                         connection = null;
632:                         continue;
633:                     }
634: 
635:                     out.put("url", address);
636:                     out.put("original_url", address);
637:                     out.put("selected_url", current);
638:                     out.put("selected_hop", followed);
639:                     out.put("http_code", code);
640:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
641:                     out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
642: 
643:                     if ((code >= 200 && code < 300) || redirect) {
644:                         out.put("status", redirect ? "redirect" : "ok");
645:                     } else {
646:                         out.put("status", "error");
647:                         out.put("message", "HTTP " + code);
648:                     }
649: 
650:                     return out;
651:                 }
652: 
653:             } catch (Exception error) {
654:                 if (attempt == 0 && isConnectionReset(error)) {
655:                     continue;
656:                 }
657: 
658:                 try {
659:                     out.put("url", address);
660:                     out.put("original_url", address);
661:                     out.put("selected_url", address);
662:                     out.put("status", "error");
663:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
664:                     out.put("message", error.getMessage() == null
665:                         ? "Bağlantı hatası" : error.getMessage());
666:                 } catch (Exception ignored) {}
667: 
668:                 return out;
669: 
670:             } finally {
674: 
675:         return out;
676:     }

536:         try {

541:

556:                     c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "ISA-Admin/1.0");
557:                     c.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
558:                     c.setRequestProperty("Range", "bytes=0-0");
559: 
560:                     int code = c.getResponseCode();
561: 
562:                     out.put("http_code", code);
563:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
564: 
565:                     if (code == 404) {
566:                         out.put("status", "skip404");
567:                     } else if (code >= 300 && code < 400) {
568:                         out.put("status", "redirect");
569:                     } else if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
570:                         out.put("status", "ok");
571:                     } else {
572:                         out.put("status", "error");

576: 
577:                 } catch (Exception e) {

579:

581:                     out.put("message",
582:                         e.getMessage() == null ? "Bağlantı hatası" : e.getMessage());
583:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
584:                     return out;
585: 
586:                 } finally {

589:             }

545:     private JSONObject scanOne(String address, int selectedHop) {
546:         JSONObject out = new JSONObject();
547:         selectedHop = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, selectedHop));
548: 
549:         for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
550:             HttpURLConnection connection = null;
551: 
552:             try {
553:                 String current = address;
554:                 JSONArray chain = new JSONArray();
555:                 chain.put(address);
556: 
557:                 java.util.HashSet<String> visited =
558:                     new java.util.HashSet<>();
559:                 visited.add(address);
560: 
561:                 int followed = 0;
568:                     if (!"http".equalsIgnoreCase(protocol) &&
569:                         !"https".equalsIgnoreCase(protocol)) {
570:                         throw new Exception("HTTP veya HTTPS adresi gerekli.");
571:                     }
572: 
573:                     connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
574:                     connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
575:                     connection.setConnectTimeout(12000);
576:                     connection.setReadTimeout(15000);
577:                     connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false);
578:                     connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "ISA-Admin/1.0");
579:                     connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
580:                     connection.setRequestProperty("Range", "bytes=0-0");
581: 
582:                     code = connection.getResponseCode();
583: 
584:                     if (code == 404) {
585:                         out.put("url", address);
586:                         out.put("original_url", address);
587:                         out.put("selected_url", current);
588:                         out.put("selected_hop", followed);
589:                         out.put("http_code", 404);
590:                         out.put("status", "skip404");
591:                         out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
592:                         return out;
593:                     }
594: 
595:                     boolean redirect = code == 301 || code == 302 ||
596:                         code == 303 || code == 307 || code == 308;
597: 
598:                     if (redirect && followed < selectedHop) {
599:                         String location = connection.getHeaderField("Location");
600: 
601:                         if (location == null || location.trim().isEmpty()) {
602:                             out.put("status", "error");
603:                             out.put("message", "Redirect Location başlığı bulunamadı.");
604:                             out.put("http_code", code);
605:                             out.put("original_url", address);
606:                             out.put("selected_url", current);
607:                             out.put("selected_hop", followed);
608:                             out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
609:                             return out;
610:                         }
611: 
612:                         String next = new URL(url, location.trim()).toString();
613: 
614:                         if (visited.contains(next)) {
615:                             out.put("status", "error");
616:                             out.put("message", "Yönlendirme döngüsü tespit edildi.");
617:                             out.put("http_code", code);
618:                             out.put("original_url", address);
619:                             out.put("selected_url", current);
620:                             out.put("selected_hop", followed);
621:                             out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
622:                             return out;
623:                         }
624: 
625:                         visited.add(next);
626:                         chain.put(next);
627:                         followed++;
628:                         current = next;
629: 
630:                         connection.disconnect();
631:                         connection = null;
632:                         continue;
633:                     }
634: 
635:                     out.put("url", address);
636:                     out.put("original_url", address);
637:                     out.put("selected_url", current);
638:                     out.put("selected_hop", followed);
639:                     out.put("http_code", code);
640:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
641:                     out.put("redirect_chain", chain);
642: 
643:                     if ((code >= 200 && code < 300) || redirect) {

645:                     } else {

541:     private JSONObject scanOne(String address) {
542:         JSONObject out = new JSONObject();
543: 
544:         try {
545:             out.put("url", address);
546: 
547:             for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
548:                 HttpURLConnection c = null;
549: 
550:                 try {
551:                     URL u = new URL(address);
552: 
553:                     String protocol = u.getProtocol();
554:                     if (!"https".equalsIgnoreCase(protocol) &&
555:                         !"http".equalsIgnoreCase(protocol)) {
556:                         out.put("status", "error");
557:                         out.put("message", "HTTP veya HTTPS adresi gerekli");
558:                         return out;
559:                     }
560: 
561:                     c = (HttpURLConnection) u.openConnection();
562:                     c.setRequestMethod("GET");
563:                     c.setConnectTimeout(12000);
564:                     c.setReadTimeout(15000);
565:                     c.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false);
566:                     c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "ISA-Admin/1.0");
567:                     c.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
568:                     c.setRequestProperty("Range", "bytes=0-0");
569: 
570:                     int code = c.getResponseCode();
571: 
572:                     out.put("http_code", code);
573:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
574: 
575:                     if (code == 404) {
576:                         out.put("status", "skip404");
577:                     } else if (code >= 300 && code < 400) {
578:                         out.put("status", "redirect");
579:                     } else if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
580:                         out.put("status", "ok");
581:                     } else {
582:                         out.put("status", "error");
583:                     }
584: 
585:                     return out;
586: 
587:                 } catch (Exception e) {
588:                     if (attempt == 0 && isConnectionReset(e)) continue;
589: 
590:                     out.put("status", "error");
591:                     out.put("message",
592:                         e.getMessage() == null ? "Bağlantı hatası" : e.getMessage());
593:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
594:                     return out;
595: 
596:                 } finally {
597:                     if (c != null) c.disconnect();
598:                 }
599:             }
600: 
601:         } catch (Exception e) {
602:             try {
603:                 out.put("status", "error");
604:                 out.put("message", e.getMessage());
605:             } catch (Exception ignored) {}
606:         }
607: 
608:         return out;
609:     }

541:     private JSONObject scanOne(String address) {
542:         JSONObject out = new JSONObject();
543: 
544:         try {
545:             out.put("url", address);
546: 
547:             for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
548:                 HttpURLConnection c = null;
549: 
550:                 try {
551:                     URL u = new URL(address);
552: 
553:                     String protocol = u.getProtocol();
554:                     if (!"https".equalsIgnoreCase(protocol) &&
555:                         !"http".equalsIgnoreCase(protocol)) {
556:                         out.put("status", "error");
557:                         out.put("message", "HTTP veya HTTPS adresi gerekli");
558:                         return out;
559:                     }
560: 
561:                     c = (HttpURLConnection) u.openConnection();
562:                     c.setRequestMethod("GET");
563:                     c.setConnectTimeout(12000);
564:                     c.setReadTimeout(15000);
565:                     c.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false);
566:                     c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "ISA-Admin/1.0");
567:                     c.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
568:                     c.setRequestProperty("Range", "bytes=0-0");
569: 
570:                     int code = c.getResponseCode();
571: 
572:                     out.put("http_code", code);
573:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
574: 
575:                     if (code == 404) {
576:                         out.put("status", "skip404");
577:                     } else if (code >= 300 && code < 400) {
578:                         out.put("status", "redirect");
579:                     } else if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
580:                         out.put("status", "ok");
581:                     } else {
582:                         out.put("status", "error");
583:                     }
584: 
585:                     return out;
586: 
587:                 } catch (Exception e) {
588:                     if (attempt == 0 && isConnectionReset(e)) continue;
589: 
590:                     out.put("status", "error");
591:                     out.put("message",
592:                         e.getMessage() == null ? "Bağlantı hatası" : e.getMessage());
593:                     out.put("retry_count", attempt);
594:                     return out;
595: 
596:                 } finally {
597:                     if (c != null) c.disconnect();
598:                 }
599:             }
600: 
601:         } catch (Exception e) {
602:             try {
603:                 out.put("status", "error");
604:                 out.put("message", e.getMessage());
605:             } catch (Exception ignored) {}
606:         }
607: 
608:         return out;

574:

523:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw) throws Exception {
524:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);
525:         JSONArray results = new JSONArray();
526: 
527:         ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1000);
528:         List<Future<JSONObject>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
529: 
530:         try {
531:             for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
532:                 final String url = input.optString(i, "").trim();
533:                 if (url.isEmpty()) continue;
534:                 tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> scanOne(url)));
535:             }
536: 
537:             for (Future<JSONObject> task : tasks) {
538:                 results.put(task.get());
539:             }
540:         } finally {
541:             pool.shutdownNow();
542:         }
543: 
544:         JSONObject response = new JSONObject();
545:         response.put("ok", true);
546:         response.put("total", results.length());
547:         response.put("results", results);
548:         return response;
549:     }

604:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw) throws Exception {
605:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);
606:         JSONArray results = new JSONArray();
607: 
608:         ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1000);
609:         List<Future<JSONObject>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
610: 
611:         try {
612:             for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
613:                 final String url = input.optString(i, "").trim();
614:                 if (url.isEmpty()) continue;
615:                 tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> scanOne(url)));
616:             }
617: 
618:             for (Future<JSONObject> task : tasks) {
619:                 results.put(task.get());
620:             }
621:         } finally {
622:             pool.shutdownNow();
623:         }
624: 
625:         JSONObject response = new JSONObject();
626:         response.put("ok", true);
627:         response.put("total", results.length());
628:         response.put("results", results);
629:         return response;
630:     }

875:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw, int selectedHop) throws Exception {
876:         final int hopLevel = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, selectedHop));
877:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);
878:         JSONArray results = new JSONArray();
879: 
880:         // İşçi sayısı korunur; fakat aynı anda yalnızca 25 görev
881:         // kuyruğa verilir. Böylece dev listelerde bellek taşması azalır.
882:         ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1000);
883:         final int BATCH_SIZE = 25;
884: 
885:         try {
886:             for (int start = 0; start < input.length(); start += BATCH_SIZE) {
887:                 List<Future<JSONObject>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
888: 
889:                 int end = Math.min(input.length(), start + BATCH_SIZE);
890: 
891:                 for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
892:                     final String url = input.optString(i, "").trim();
894: 
895:                     tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> scanOne(url, hopLevel)));
896:                 }
897: 
898:                 for (Future<JSONObject> task : tasks) {
899:                     try {
900:                         results.put(task.get());
901:                     } catch (Exception taskError) {
902:                         JSONObject failed = new JSONObject();
903:                         failed.put("ok", false);
904:                         failed.put("status", "error");
905:                         failed.put("error", String.valueOf(taskError.getMessage()));
906:                         results.put(failed);
907:                     }
912:         } finally {
913:             pool.shutdownNow();
914:         }
915: 
916:         JSONObject response = new JSONObject();
917:         response.put("ok", true);
918:         response.put("total", results.length());
919:         response.put("results", results);
920:         return response;
921:     }

826:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw, int selectedHop) throws Exception {
827:         final int hopLevel = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, selectedHop));
828:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);
829:         JSONArray results = new JSONArray();
830: 
831:         ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1000);
832:         List<Future<JSONObject>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
833: 
834:         try {
835:             for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
836:                 final String url = input.optString(i, "").trim();
837:                 if (url.isEmpty()) continue;
838:                 tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> scanOne(url, hopLevel)));
839:             }
840: 
841:             for (Future<JSONObject> task : tasks) {
842:                 results.put(task.get());
843:             }
844:         } finally {
845:             pool.shutdownNow();
846:         }
847: 
848:         JSONObject response = new JSONObject();
849:         response.put("ok", true);
850:         response.put("total", results.length());
851:         response.put("results", results);
852:         return response;
853:     }

822:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw) throws Exception {
823:         return scanUrls(raw, 0);
824:     }
825: 
826:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw, int selectedHop) throws Exception {
827:         final int hopLevel = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, selectedHop));
828:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);
829:         JSONArray results = new JSONArray();
830: 
831:         ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1000);
832:         List<Future<JSONObject>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
833: 
834:         try {
835:             for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
836:                 final String url = input.optString(i, "").trim();
837:                 if (url.isEmpty()) continue;
838:                 tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> scanOne(url, hopLevel)));
839:             }
840: 
841:             for (Future<JSONObject> task : tasks) {
842:                 results.put(task.get());
843:             }
844:         } finally {
845:             pool.shutdownNow();
846:         }
847: 
848:         JSONObject response = new JSONObject();
849:         response.put("ok", true);
850:         response.put("total", results.length());
851:         response.put("results", results);
852:         return response;
853:     }

822:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw) throws Exception {
823:         return scanUrls(raw, 0);
824:     }
825: 
826:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw, int selectedHop) throws Exception {
827:         final int hopLevel = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, selectedHop));
828:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);
829:         JSONArray results = new JSONArray();
830: 
831:         ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1000);
832:         List<Future<JSONObject>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
833: 
834:         try {
835:             for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
836:                 final String url = input.optString(i, "").trim();
837:                 if (url.isEmpty()) continue;
838:                 tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> scanOne(url, hopLevel)));
839:             }
840: 
841:             for (Future<JSONObject> task : tasks) {
842:                 results.put(task.get());
843:             }
844:         } finally {
845:             pool.shutdownNow();
846:         }
847: 
848:         JSONObject response = new JSONObject();
849:         response.put("ok", true);
850:         response.put("total", results.length());
851:         response.put("results", results);
852:         return response;
853:     }

756:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);
757:         JSONArray results = new JSONArray();
758: 
759:         ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1000);

763:             for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
764:                 final String url = input.optString(i, "").trim();
765:                 if (url.isEmpty()) continue;
766:                 tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> scanOne(url)));
767:             }

755:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw) throws Exception {
756:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);
757:         JSONArray results = new JSONArray();
758: 
759:         ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1000);
760:         List<Future<JSONObject>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
761: 
762:         try {
763:             for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
764:                 final String url = input.optString(i, "").trim();
765:                 if (url.isEmpty()) continue;
766:                 tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> scanOne(url)));
767:             }
768: 
769:             for (Future<JSONObject> task : tasks) {
770:                 results.put(task.get());
771:             }
772:         } finally {
773:             pool.shutdownNow();
774:         }
775: 
776:         JSONObject response = new JSONObject();
777:         response.put("ok", true);
778:         response.put("total", results.length());
779:         response.put("results", results);
780:         return response;
781:     }

778:         return scanUrls(raw, 0);
779:     }

781:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw, int selectedHop) throws Exception {
782:         final int hopLevel = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, selectedHop));
783:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);
784:         JSONArray results = new JSONArray();
785: 
786:         // İşçi sayısı korunur; fakat aynı anda yalnızca 25 görev
787:         // kuyruğa verilir. Böylece dev listelerde bellek taşması azalır.
788:         ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1000);
789:         final int BATCH_SIZE = 25;
790: 
791:         try {
792:             for (int start = 0; start < input.length(); start += BATCH_SIZE) {
793:                 List<Future<JSONObject>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
794: 
795:                 int end = Math.min(input.length(), start + BATCH_SIZE);
796: 
797:                 for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
798:                     final String url = input.optString(i, "").trim();
800: 
801:                     tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> scanOne(url, hopLevel)));
802:                 }
803: 
804:                 for (Future<JSONObject> task : tasks) {
805:                     try {
806:                         results.put(task.get());
807:                     } catch (Exception taskError) {
808:                         JSONObject failed = new JSONObject();
809:                         failed.put("ok", false);
810:                         failed.put("status", "error");
811:                         failed.put("error", String.valueOf(taskError.getMessage()));
812:                         results.put(failed);
813:                     }
818:         } finally {
819:             pool.shutdownNow();
820:         }
821: 
822:         JSONObject response = new JSONObject();
823:         response.put("ok", true);
824:         response.put("total", results.length());
825:         response.put("results", results);
826:         return response;
827:     }

875:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw, int selectedHop) throws Exception {

877:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);

755:     private JSONObject scanUrls(String raw) throws Exception {
756:         JSONArray input = new JSONArray(raw);
757:         JSONArray results = new JSONArray();
758: 
759:         ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1000);
760:         List<Future<JSONObject>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
761: 
762:         try {
763:             for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
764:                 final String url = input.optString(i, "").trim();
765:                 if (url.isEmpty()) continue;
766:                 tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> scanOne(url)));
767:             }
768: 
769:             for (Future<JSONObject> task : tasks) {
770:                 results.put(task.get());
771:             }
772:         } finally {
773:             pool.shutdownNow();
774:         }
775: 
776:         JSONObject response = new JSONObject();
777:         response.put("ok", true);
778:         response.put("total", results.length());
779:         response.put("results", results);
780:         return response;
781:     }
